one_line: A first-person making-of story over page flips, ending with one comment word said and written on screen.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a toddler claps on a sofa as a box is handed over; 0:02 top-down, hands open a MeBook.ai box; 0:03 the cover shows a mother and toddler. Voice and subtitle: "זו המתנה הכי מרגשת שהכנתי ל" and a name.
q1_hook.why: A superlative first-person claim, said and written together, with a child reacting and a box opening inside 3 s (H1, H6, E1). A face is on screen from 0:01 and a voice from 0:00 (H4). The cover shows the idea at 0:03, but no benefit is said until 0:08 (S1, H2).

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: From 0:39, spoken (transcript) and written: comment "ספר" for a link with a code. The caption repeats it and asks which moment with the children viewers would put in such a book.
q2_flow.why: A first-person arc, gift, why, how, a second book, holds 44 s (K2, R2). The 10 s static sofa shot carries the voice with little new to see (R1). The montage at 0:05 to 0:12 is quick, but its clips do not show the product (R3).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) at 0:39 to 0:44 and written 0:40 to 0:43: "ואם גם אתם רוצים להכין לילדים" ... "תגיבו \"ספר\" ואשלח לכם לינק". Caption: the same keyword for her code, plus an open question about a moment for the book.
q3_cta.why: One keyword that delivers a real discount, said, shown after the story and repeated in the caption (C1, C3, C6). The word is generic. The caption adds a second comment ask, an open question from the viewer's own life, which splits the comments (C5, R6).

q4_shown.what: The MeBook.ai box and a cover with an illustrated mother and toddler, 0:00-0:05; a montage of toddler clips; page flips of mother-and-child scenes, 0:13-0:17; mother and toddler reading, 0:17-0:27; a dinosaur book, 0:27-0:33. No price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: A mother's first-person making-of story, with the child beside the book, is first-hand vouching (S6), and the book is handled from 0:02 (S1). The illustrated mother wears a scarf like hers, but no photo sits beside a page (S2). Ordering is only said (S8). The toddler's face is on camera (S5).

q5_edit.what: 32 detected shots in 44.4 s, about 1.4 s each, but 16 are one flicker transition at 0:08 to 0:10, so about 10 real segments. Hard cuts. A fast montage to 0:12, then a static 10 s sofa shot. Word-by-word subtitles. Ends on a hug.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 2 s and a quick montage give early energy (E1, E2), and the flicker effect is a rapid change (E2). The static 10 s shot carries a long stretch of voice (R1). Word-by-word subtitles follow the voice (E4). It ends on the ask with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother turns trips, laughs and hugs with her toddler into a personalised book, then orders a second, a dinosaur adventure. It serves parents who want to keep fast-passing moments.
q6_topic.why: "הילדים שלנו גדלים כל כך מהר" is a feeling many parents share (K6), told in first person (K2). The claim is a keepsake, a modest one (K4). It is gift framing without a named occasion (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld eye-level medium shots of a mother and a toddler on a grey sofa in daylight; handheld top-down hands on a wooden floor opening the box and flipping pages; a static medium shot for 10 s; a top-down shot of two books on a table.
q7_filmed.why: Home footage of a real parent and child looks native (H8, F7). Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5), and the cover and spreads fill the frame (F4). The mother speaks over the footage, never to the lens (F6).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold white word-by-word subtitles with a dark outline, 1 to 4 words, about 66 to 72% down: "זו המתנה הכי מרגשת" (0:01), "הילדים שלנו גדלים" (0:05), "אז החלטתי להפוך את הרגעים" (0:09), "יצרתי בעזרת AI איורים" (0:14), "את כל זה יצרתי דרך MEBOOK" (0:22), "מבחינתי זו אחת המתנות הכי מרגשות" (0:37), "תגיבו \"ספר\" ואשלח לכם לינק" (0:42). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "זו אחת המתנות הכי מרגשות שאפשר להכין לילד. 🤍" About 65 words: the feeling, the keyword "ספר" for her discount code, an open question about one moment for the book. No hashtags, no brand name, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles carry every spoken line, so it works muted (T1, T2), but they sit inside the bottom 35% over the picture (T4, F2). The caption's first line is a gift line, and the keyword is lower down (T7, C3). No brand name or disclosure word in the caption (T7, T8).

weak_points: "AI" named on screen; an unrelated toddler montage; ordering only said; no price or delivery; no photo beside a page; the toddler's face and name; no disclosure word.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the box opening and top-down page flips with a first-person voice over; end with one comment word that delivers a real offer, said and written.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's; whether music plays; the toddler's identity in the montage. The child's name is in the voice, subtitles and cover, not quoted. Correction to coded file: the second book's cover reads "אני והדינוזאור שלי" in the frames, so the transcript's "דינוזאור עם הותם" is a mishearing.
